//: HazeHub runs on the Firebase SPARK (free) plan.
Only Firestore is deployed to Firebase. The API and the web app are both
served by the HazeHub server process running on the team's own scouting
laptop (see run-server.ps1), which is what keeps this off the Blaze plan:
Cloud Run and Cloud Functions both require Blaze, but reading and writing
Firestore from your own machine with a service account does not.
Firebase Hosting is intentionally NOT configured. Hosting itself is free,
but a page served over https from *.web.app cannot call an http API on a
LAN address (browsers block mixed content), and rewriting /api/** to a
backend needs Cloud Run, i.e. Blaze. Serving the app from the same
process as the API avoids both problems and works with no internet at
